name: enaml-intellisense
description: Enaml and Enaml-Web language support with navigation, completion and diagnostics.

enaml.languageServer.enabled.description: Enable Enaml language intelligence. Reload the window after changing this setting.

enaml.sourcePaths.description: Additional Python/Enaml import roots, such as project src directories or virtual environment site-packages. Relative paths are resolved against workspace folders.

enaml.diagnostics.enabled.description: Report Enaml syntax, indentation and name diagnostics.

enaml.diagnostics.indentation.description: Check block indentation, including mixed tabs and spaces.

enaml.diagnostics.unresolvedNames.description: Report unknown names in statically analyzed expressions.

enaml.diagnostics.unresolvedImports.description: Warn when an import cannot be found in workspace roots or sourcePaths.

enaml.diagnostics.unresolvedMembers.description: Check members on known receivers. Dynamic framework attributes can require disabling this check.

enaml.diagnostics.unresolvedTypes.description: Check explicit annotations and base class names.

enaml.diagnostics.duplicates.description: Check repeated declarations in the same scope.

enaml.diagnostics.unusedImports.description: Warn about unused imports. Imports used for side effects may appear unused.

enaml.diagnostics.bindings.description: Check assignment bindings against fully resolved component declarations. Disable for dynamic properties.

enaml.completion.snippets.description: Suggest Enaml declaration and component snippets.

enaml.completion.autoImports.description: Suggest imports from workspace modules after typing at least two characters.

enaml.formatting.enabled.description: Enable conservative indentation and trailing whitespace formatting.

enaml.semanticTokens.enabled.description: Color resolved declarations and references by symbol kind.

enaml.inlayHints.enabled.description: Show inferred constructor types and parameter name hints.

enaml.codeLens.enabled.description: Show reference counts above classes and functions. Workspace scans run when a lens is resolved.
